notes.title: Starwulf v2.2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Missions and space fights with enemy fleets
[*] Space flight scene is changed from boring "select correct brick, rotate it, target precily and click shoot" to more arcade like action
- Equip you ship with auto-rotate and auto-shoot, select correct brick,  move position and ship handles the rest
- There are still larger asteroids and enemies, which require brick puzzle solving
[*] Redesigned black hole scene and improved graphics on hyperspace scene
[*] Game runs in landscape mode on PC with wider play area
[/list]

notes.title: Starwulf 2.1 is released
notes.content:
Key Updates:

- Introducing new planet types, which needs to be rotated to be solved. Opens up a total new dimension to the brick puzzle planets.

- Random encounters with Space Titans - new brick puzzle

- More hostile enemies, with weaponry and improved boss battle

- Planetary rescue missions and new achievement: Guardian of Space 

- Improved keyboard, gamepad and mouse controls, which are visible in Options menu

- Lots of minor bug fixes and improvements for more enticing gameplay

notes.title: Starwulf 2.0 is released
notes.content:
Key Updates:

Enhanced Gameplay: Faster progression, engaging missions, and special events for a dynamic adventure. And yes, now there are more often enemies in the asteroid scene.

Improved Controls: Now with gamepad and keyboard support, alongside the original mouse controls. PS3/PC and PS4 gamepads currently supported.

Steam Achievements: New achievements to unlock as you explore and conquer.

Diverse Mechanics: A blend of space trading, puzzles, and action for a varied and exciting experience.

We acknowledge our initial release was a stepping stone; Starwulf 2.0 is the game it was meant to be from the start. Whether you're a returning player or new to the cockpit, there's never been a better time to dive into the Starwulf universe.

Thank you to our community for your feedback and support. Join us in this revamped space adventure today!

notes.title: Update note for 1.3.1
notes.content:
Micropayments are removed
- The micro payments were included to game for players, who might want to speed up the progress of game (i.e. take shortcuts). 
- Due negative feedback, the micro payments are now removed.

Secret Item Collector is available from the start 
- It is now possible to collect items in hyperspace in first level
- You need to buy Extended collector for collecting secret clues

Game starts in easy difficulty level
- The game is quite hard (too hard) in normal level so the default level is changed

Fix to auto-targeting available in the start of tutorial
- This caused a confusion, because players could use auto-targeting before tutorial got there.

Minor bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Starwulf is released
notes.content:
Couple of months has passed since the Playtest of Starwulf. 

During that time the game has went through a graphical facelift with new effects.
Additionally there are end game, trophies and stats. 

Now the Starwulf v1.2.0 is released and also a demo version is available.

Also here is a video "Story of Starwulf", which introduces you to the plot of the game: https://youtu.be/XTGI_1WPQV0

notes.title: Starwulf playtest
notes.content:
Game is playable and can be finished, but we have plans to add some additional features to the final version. Based on the feedback of playtest modifications will be implemented - so you feedback is valuable and warmly welcome!!!!

Beta version of the game is also available in the Google Play for mobile platforms,

PC version can be played with mouse. Keyboard support is at the moment partial: 
- aswd (brick controls), arrow keys (ship controls) and space (shoot) can be used.

Game has a junior mode, which suitable for beginners. Themode can be selected in the first start or game reset. In this mode there is no bricks, only missiles and specials. Mode can be changed to normal from game options.

Game has also an experimental Extreme mode, which is limited to basic ship type with minimal equipments. It should be a hard one to finish.
